answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 3198 Country: United Kingdom Title: I had a dream of me reciting chapters of the quraan to my dad in my house, My dad first asked me whether I memorized surahs from the quraan and I replied 'yes'. Maulana Saab, was is the meaning of this dream. Question: Salem Alaikum I had a dream of me reciting chapters of the quraan to my dad in my house, My dad first asked me whether I memorized surahs from the quraan and I replied 'yes'. Maulana Saab, was is the meaning of this dream. Answer ID: 3198 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 210/205=B) It is expected that you shall be granted the honour of memorizing the Holy Quran. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
